questions.question: Compare L1 and L2 regularization methods.
questions.solution_html:
• Compare L1 and L2 regularization methods.
  • Regularization is a technique used in machine learning to reduce overfitting by making the model
  • simpler and improving its performance on new data.
  • L1 Regularization (Lasso Regression)
  • • Also called Lasso Regression.
  • • Adds the absolute value of the coefficients as a penalty to the loss function.
  • • Shrinks some coefficients exactly to zero, effectively removing less important features.
  • • Useful for feature selection, especially when there are many features.
  • L2 Regularization (Ridge Regression)
  • • Also called Ridge Regression.
  • • Adds the square of the coefficients as a penalty to the loss function.
  • • Reduces the size of coefficients but does not make them zero.
  • • Keeps all features while reducing their influence, helping prevent overfitting.
questions.final_answer: • Keeps all features while reducing their influence, helping prevent overfitting
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
